title: fix(agents): preserve CLI bootstrap from configured workspace
body:
Fixes #180510

## What Problem This Solves

CLI-backed sessions running in a spawned project folder lose the configured agent's instructions, identity, user profile, and memory, or replace them with that folder's files.

## User Impact

CLI sessions retain the agent's bootstrap context and append only the execution folder's `AGENTS.md`, while commands still run in the selected folder. Explicit bootstrap-workspace overrides remain supported; no configuration changes are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

CLI preparation fell back to the execution workspace when the reply path supplied no bootstrap override. The embedded runner already kept agent identity separate from project instructions.

The maintainer rewrite moves that existing layering into the shared bootstrap-file loader, then uses it from both runners. Filtering, provenance, and the combined context budget retain their existing owners. This removes the PR-only helper and its duplicate context construction. The contributor's regression intent is retained in the existing CLI preparation suite, with cases for the configured workspace and an explicit override. Thanks @sunlit-deng; the original contributor commit remains in this branch's history.

## Evidence

- Source confirmation on main `b389baf8895b209dbc5252487bc672c0e0c45aba`: [`prepare.ts:667`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b389baf8895b209dbc5252487bc672c0e0c45aba/src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts#L667) uses `params.bootstrapWorkspaceDir ?? workspaceDir`; the reply run-state path forwards the execution workspace without a bootstrap root. This violates the existing [workspace-bootstrap contract](https://docs.openclaw.ai/concepts/system-prompt#workspace-bootstrap-injection).
- Regression: `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.test.ts`, `keeps agent bootstrap and layers only execution AGENTS`. Both cases use real bootstrap-file loading through `prepareCliRunContext`. On base, the configured-root case loses the canonical markers; the explicit-root case lacks the execution `AGENTS.md` marker. Assertions also protect loader order/provenance, cwd, and exclusion of execution `USER.md`/`MEMORY.md`. Baseline execution was not performed locally.
- Existing embedded-runner boundary tests retain layering, provenance, skip, and unreadable-file coverage; both runners still use the shared context-budget builder. PR CI supplies the regressions and selected affected-consumer checks.
- `git diff --check`: passed. Production: +35/−35 (net 0); tests: +47/−0; docs: +0/−0 versus merged main. Documentation already states the restored behavior.
- Local dependency installation was attempted only on trusted main and refused: this Mac has Node 26.12.0, while main requires >=26.12.1 (or its supported Node 24 range). Local tests, lint/format, and typechecks were skipped under maintainer policy; no engine bypass or runtime download was used. Exact-head CI run [39907760597](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39907760597/job/120263905473) passed all 112 CLI preparation cases in 47.72 seconds; the two new cases took 220 ms and 158 ms. The existing suite owns the broad CLI preparation contracts; these cases add about 0.38 seconds rather than another cold suite boot.
- Live Gateway/channel e2e and upgrade proof were skipped per maintainer policy. ClawSweeper's previous review had no code findings; its proof-only hold is superseded by that policy.
- Original CI run [39770843276](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39770843276/job/119799084679) failed `oxc(no-map-spread)` in the PR-only helper. That helper is removed in this rewrite. Independent Codex autoreview passed at P2 with no actionable findings, including fresh full-delta reviews after the CI repairs. The required subsequent main merge changed none of the reviewed owner/test files. Exact-head [CI run 39907760597](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39907760597) passed on `1692710e37261ac6a7d788db939c66bb312b2022`: 43 successful jobs, zero failures, including the CI gate, selected tests, format/lint, and typechecks.

- First rewritten-head CI [39905866294](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39905866294) exposed PR-caused import shadowing, one formatting error, and an incorrect regression assertion: the prompt renderer intentionally groups AGENTS before MEMORY. The repair aliases the real loader import, wraps the assignment, and checks appended file order/provenance in the prompt report while preserving all rendered-content assertions. No runtime behavior change was needed for these CI repairs.

- The next CI run passed the regression suite and core lint, but still flagged formatting in the test file. A final test-only alias/format correction changes no runtime behavior or assertions; the final exact-head CI run passed both formatting and the regression suite.
